items.scope: Vulnerabilities in the AHA! website and other AHA! controlled assets, as well as vulnerabilities identified in assets owned, operated, or maintained by another organization unless covered by the scope of another CNA.
OPPO devices only.
openHarmony issues only.
Western Digital products including WD, SanDisk, SanDisk Professional, G-Technology, and HGST only.

All Ribose products and services, including open source projects, supported products, and end-of-life/end-of-service products.

Vulnerabilities that are discovered, validated, and coordinated through the Hackrate Ethical Hacking Platform, including: software, web applications, APIs, and cloud services; vulnerabilities validated and triaged by our internal security team; and findings disclosed under our coordination that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Xerox Corporation issues only.

Vulnerabilities in software discovered by National Cyber Security Centre SK-CERT, and vulnerabilities reported to National Cyber Security Centre SK-CERT for coordinated disclosure, which are not in another CNA’s scope.
